target.name: Cat's Eye Nebula
target.notes: High-surface-brightness planetary nebula with a bright core and faint outer halo — HDR short subs protect the core while long subs pull the halo.

target.name: Orion Nebula
target.notes: Piggy-600 HDR goal (2026-10-28): 120 s main subs plus a 15 s short set (10% of the time) for the Trapezium / Huygens core, stacked apart (osc_hdr/master_OSC_short) and blended into the clipped core. Rises about 21:30 local in late October at AARO: a second-half-of-the-night target.
